smiles: string
}) => any;

type assess_adme_properties = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string,
// Target pH for ionization/logD estimation (default: 7.4).
ph?: number

// Screen a molecule for toxicophores — structural motifs associated with specific toxicity mechanisms. type remove_salts = (_: {
// SMILES string (may contain salts).
smiles: string

// Predict CYP450 metabolism: returns top 3 ranked metabolites with SMILES, reaction types, and priority scores for Phase 1 (oxidation, reduction, hydrolysis) and Phase 2 (glucuronidation, sulfation, GSH conjugation). // SMILES string of the molecule.
